title: Glowing light bulb
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <g>
    <!-- glow halo -->
    <circle cx="50" cy="42" r="34" fill="#FFE066" opacity="0.15"/>
    <circle cx="50" cy="42" r="26" fill="#FFE066" opacity="0.22"/>
    <!-- glass bulb -->
    <circle cx="50" cy="40" r="22" fill="#FFF3A8"/>
    <circle cx="50" cy="40" r="22" fill="none" stroke="#FFD84D" stroke-width="2.5"/>
    <!-- inner glow highlight -->
    <circle cx="50" cy="40" r="15" fill="#FFFBE0" opacity="0.9"/>
    <!-- filament -->
    <path d="M43 52 L43 44 Q43 38 46.5 38 Q50 38 50 42 Q50 38 53.5 38 Q57 38 57 44 L57 52"
          fill="none" stroke="#FF9E2E" stroke-width="2.5" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
    <!-- shine on glass -->
    <path d="M38 30 Q42 26 47 26" fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="3" stroke-linecap="round" opacity="0.8"/>
    <!-- base / screw cap -->
    <rect x="42" y="62" width="16" height="6" rx="2" fill="#C9CBD6"/>
    <rect x="43" y="68" width="14" height="5" rx="2" fill="#AEB1BE"/>
    <rect x="44" y="73" width="12" height="5" rx="2" fill="#C9CBD6"/>
    <path d="M45 78 L50 86 L55 78 Z" fill="#8E93A3"/>
    <!-- cap bands -->
    <line x1="42" y1="66" x2="58" y2="66" stroke="#E6E8F0" stroke-width="1.2"/>
    <line x1="43" y1="71" x2="57" y2="71" stroke="#E6E8F0" stroke-width="1.2"/>
  </g>
</svg>
